title: [SOLVED] GNOME48 Login Screen Stuck After prolonged blank screen
body: After logging out or resuming from a prolonged blank screen state (suspend turned off), the GNOME login screen (GDM) becomes unresponsive. The interface does not react to keyboard input (password field), mouse clicks (e.g., user selection, power menu), or any UI interactions. The only workaround is to switch to another TTY (e.g., Ctrl+Alt+F3), then return to the original TTY (Ctrl+Alt+F1), after which the login screen starts working again. # System Details Report --- ## Report details -
